# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — teach the hidden-replay generalization gap + type fidelity + verify-before-done
- Changes I made:
  - prompt.md (cluster 1, KNOWLEDGE): new block "YOUR CODE IS RE-RUN ON HIDDEN DATA" — compute from the input at run time; never paste/cache preview values; never copy a "desired/answer/sample/after" sheet into the answer cells; derive row/col extents dynamically; base positions on headers.
  - prompt.md (cluster 2, OUTPUT-CONTRACT): new block "MATCH THE EXPECTED VALUE'S TYPE AND FORMAT" — numbers as numbers (no str()), copy exact casing of labels that exist elsewhere, preserve neighbor type, empty only when intended.
  - task_template.md (cluster 3, STRUCTURE): replaced the "once that file exists, you are done" line with a required verification round (re-open output, print answer_position, confirm present+typed+computed-not-hardcoded, else fix). "Done" now requires a passing read-back.
- Expected effect + safety:
  - Edit A targets the dominant `[1,0,0]`/`[1,1,0]` signature (passes instance 1, fails the text-substituted re-run on instances 2/3): 51262 (pasted 30/20/0), 50755 ([25,3,25,22,60]), 250-20 (copies "Desired outcome" sheet), 53957 (range(15,26)), 267-18, 58890, 32975, 48588, 49782, 30930. Safe because all 49 passing tasks scored [1,1,1] across 3 varying-data instances → they already generalize; the rule only describes existing good behavior.
  - Edit B targets 585-41 (str() coercion), 50486 ("Chep" vs sheet "CHEP"), 48983 (None vs empty). Additive; passing tasks already write correct types.
  - Edit C is structural, makes verification a precondition of finishing; passing tasks verify and stop with identical output. A formula cell reads back as a populated string, so the 5 passing formula tasks are untouched.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — seed-only; LEDGER/RUNMAP empty.
- Refuted hypotheses / NOT tried on purpose: did NOT add a global "never write Excel formulas / always write literal values" rule. 5 PASSING tasks (35747, 37962, 45581, 49237, 54675) pass BY writing formulas (LibreOffice recalcs them); and failing formula tasks ask for formulas just like the passing ones, so formula-vs-value is not a safe discriminator. Left the existing "prefer literal values" line as-is.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: bespoke algorithm/task-misinterpretation (~15 tasks: 39946, 53305, 32468, 6698, 47699, 14207, 4225, 34-5, 347-49, 146-49, 577-40, 413-15, 398-14, 55912, 55039). These are ambiguous-spec comprehension errors, not clean knowledge gaps. Candidate next lever: worked-example snippets for recurring sub-patterns — robust color/font detection (openpyxl rgb/indexed/theme), and reading existing formula results with data_only=True (47699 loaded data_only=False and never saw the values).
- ENVIRONMENT fault handed back: 45944 — feedback explicitly states "formula recalculation FAILED … Not a prompt defect — do not optimize against it." Did not work around it.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Focus next iteration: if this is accepted, attack cluster 4 with worked examples (color detection, data_only reads) as BOUNDED additive method snippets, verifying each against its trace and confirming no passing color/formula task changes.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.560 Δ=+0.022 · fixed={44264, 48588, 50486, 50682, 51262, 53023, 53957, 55224} · broke={2768, 31420, 399-14, 42930, 56561, 58484}.
<!-- cand_0001: ACCEPTED val=0.560 Δ=+0.022 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — breadth across cand_0001's deferred "bespoke" cluster + fix the 399-14 regression
- Changes I made (all additive; no global rule loosened):
  - prompt.md (cluster: input-extent, KNOWLEDGE): bullet in the RE-RUN block — answer_position bounds only WHERE you write, NOT the extent of the input; read/aggregate over ALL data rows, never bound the input loop by the answer range's last row or preview count. Targets 250-20, 30930, 32975.
  - prompt.md (cluster: composite-key/grouping, KNOWLEDGE): bullet — build keys from EVERY jointly-identifying column; detect groups by CONTIGUOUS runs and reset per boundary (no global value-keyed dict); never tie an output cell's position to a column/sheet the instruction says is unrelated. Targets 58890, 32975, 55912.
  - prompt.md (cluster: paraphrase, KNOWLEDGE): new block "REPRODUCE THE STATED OPERATION EXACTLY" — same operators/value set, POSITIONAL (not sorted/ranked) refs, Excel blank→0 in lookups/#N/A on miss, honor explicit cell refs, and detect color/bold in rich-text runs or CF rules (not cell.fill/font.color). Targets 6698, 50755, 48983, 14207.
  - prompt.md + task_template.md (cluster: empty-vs-zero, KNOWLEDGE+STRUCTURE): new block "BLANK vs ZERO" (write only where the op produces a value; "remain unchanged" ⇒ leave as-is, don't write 0/"-"; write 0 where an aggregate over blanks yields 0) AND refined verify item (a) so it no longer pressures filling genuinely-blank cells. Targets the 399-14 regression + 48983, 398-14.
  - prompt.md + task_template.md (cluster: examples, STRUCTURE): new block "USE ANY EXAMPLE AS A CHECK" + verify item (d) — reproduce the LOGIC that yields any stated/embedded example and confirm the output matches it, else revise (reproduce logic, never copy the sample). Targets 2768, 413-15, 32023, 39946.
- Expected effect + why safe: each rule DESCRIBES the behavior the 51 [1,1,1] passing tasks already exhibit (they generalize / match their examples / write correct blanks), so their trajectories don't change; additions are narrowing/knowledge, never a loosened decision. The one modified line (verify item (a)) is made MORE accurate, not more permissive, and reverses the exact over-fill that broke 399-14 under cand_0001 (agent wrote O=0 for "remain unchanged" rows).
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 ACCEPTED (fixed 8, broke 6). I am repairing one of its regressions (399-14, empty-vs-zero) and decomposing its deferred "cluster 4 (bespoke misreads)" into the six prose-fixable sub-patterns above. Did NOT touch the RE-RUN or TYPE/FORMAT blocks (they worked) beyond adding two bullets.
- Refuted hypotheses (never re-test): global "never use formulas / always literals" — cand_0001 note + 5 passing formula tasks (35747/37962/45581/49237/54675) prove formula-vs-value is not a safe discriminator. Left "prefer literals" untouched.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: volatile "current date" (32023, 34-5 — ambiguous snapshot vs today=2026-08-02); genuinely underspecified specs (55039, 53449, 53305, 10281, 254-34, 269-44). No safe general prose fix without leaking gold.
- Plateau signal: only one prior RESULT (accepted, +0.022) — not a plateau. Staying on the prompt lever (breadth of knowledge/structure additions) rather than switching to a code/tool lever.
- ENVIRONMENT faults handed back (do NOT optimize against): 45944 (known recalc), 53062 (48k-row recalc), 4225 & 55258 (output provably reproduces the instruction's own example yet [0,0,0] — grader/type fault).
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, watch which of the six clusters actually converted; if the empty-vs-zero refinement re-broke a task, redesign it as a pure knowledge rule without touching verify item (a). If rejected, bisect the five edits (the composite-key and example-check blocks are the least-certain) via the RESULT's broke set.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.571 Δ=+0.011 · fixed={2768, 31420, 347-49, 399-14, 47699, 50755, 56561} · broke={18137, 353-19, 36478, 45300, 50486, 53957}.
